subject: Future Tech
title: Existential Risk
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Existential Risk.

hook.text: Leading AI researchers put the probability of AGI causing human extinction between 5% and 50%.

buildup.text: Unaligned AGI could outthink every safety measure. It doesn't need weapons—it needs the internet, persuasion, and time.

discovery.text: Hinton, Bengio, and hundreds of top researchers signed statements warning that AI extinction risk is real and urgent.

climax.text: The AI safety community says: even a 5% chance of extinction warrants massive investment in safety.

punchline.text: The experts disagree on the odds. They agree the stakes are everything.

quiz.question: What range do some AI researchers give for AGI extinction risk?
